name: clio-mcp
description: Work in Clio Manage from Claude: documents (read, create on letterhead, new versions), time entries, billing data, matters, contacts, tasks, calendar – plus a validated generic API call. Deleting is not possible; write confirmation is configurable.
long_description:
MCP server connecting Claude Desktop (and Cowork) to Clio Manage through the official Clio API v4, in all Clio regions (US, EU, CA, AU).

**55 tools**: OAuth sign-in (tokens encrypted with Windows DPAPI), documents (search, read DOCX/PDF text – scanned pages are returned as images Claude can read –, download for editing, new versions, new documents created on your letterhead/template and saved to a "Claude" folder in the matter), time and expense entries, billing data (bills, line items, unbilled matters, outstanding balances), matters, contacts, tasks, calendar, notes, communications, users, custom fields; and a generic API call validated against Clio's OpenAPI description.

**Safety model**: **DELETE is never performed** (not even through the generic API call); every write tool can return a preview, and the *Write confirmation* setting can require your approval for every write; every call is written to a local audit log.

You need your own Clio Developer Application (App Key and App Secret) – see the README for a step-by-step guide.

tools.name: clio_authenticate
tools.description: Sign in to Clio (OAuth 2.0); returns the authorization URL

tools.name: clio_logout
tools.description: Sign out on this computer (optionally revoke the token in Clio)

tools.name: clio_describe_api
tools.description: Describe Clio API endpoints and schemas from the bundled OpenAPI catalog

tools.name: clio_api_request
tools.description: Generic API call (GET/POST/PATCH only; validated against OpenAPI; writes need confirm)

tools.name: clio_diagnostics
tools.description: Connector diagnostics (configuration, token store, work folder)

tools.name: clio_document_read
tools.description: Read a document's content: text (DOCX/PDF/TXT) or scanned pages as images

tools.name: clio_document_download
tools.description: Download a document to the local work folder

tools.name: clio_document_upload_version
tools.description: Upload a new version of a document

tools.name: clio_document_upload
tools.description: Upload a new document into the matter's Claude folder

tools.name: clio_document_write
tools.description: New version of a DOCX document from text (keeps header, footer and styles)

tools.name: clio_document_create_from_letterhead
tools.description: New document on a letterhead/template (text filled in server-side)

tools.name: clio_document_comment_add
tools.description: Add a comment to a document

tools.name: clio_timer
tools.description: Timer (status/start; stopping is done in Clio)

region.title: Clio region
region.description: Region of your Clio account: us (app.clio.com), eu (eu.app.clio.com), ca (ca.app.clio.com) or au (au.app.clio.com). Required.

locale.title: Language of messages
locale.description: Language of the connector's messages (previews, errors, notes): en (default) or cs. Tool descriptions are always English; Claude answers in your language regardless.

confirm_mode.title: Write confirmation
confirm_mode.description: auto (default): Claude writes to Clio directly when your request is complete and asks only when information is missing. ask: every write first shows a preview and needs your approval (enforced by the server with a confirmation token).

client_id.title: Clio App Key (Client ID)
client_id.description: App Key of the Developer Application you created in your Clio developer portal (see README, step 1).

client_secret.title: Clio App Secret (Client Secret)
client_secret.description: App Secret of the same application. Stored in the Windows Credential Manager by Claude Desktop.

work_dir.title: Work folder for documents
work_dir.description: Absolute path of the folder where documents are downloaded for editing (default: Documents\Clio MCP in your user profile). Connect the same folder in Cowork.

claude_folder.title: Folder name in Clio for documents created by Claude
claude_folder.description: Name of the folder created in each matter's documents for files Claude creates (default: Claude).

default_template.title: Default letterhead / template
default_template.description: Name (or name prefix, or id) of the Clio Document Template used for new documents when no per-user letterhead applies. Leave empty if you have a single template or will pick one per document.

letterheads.title: Per-user letterheads (optional)
letterheads.description: Map of user e-mail to template name/prefix, separated by semicolons, e.g. jane@firm.com=Jane_letterhead;john@firm.com=John_letterhead.

internal_template.title: Template for internal documents (optional)
internal_template.description: Template name/prefix used when a document is created with kind=internal (e.g. a plain document without letterhead).
